journey.name: wear remove wallet
journey.description:
Confirming Remove wallet deletes the wallet from the watch: onboarding opens, a restart stays on onboarding, and the encrypted seed file is gone. Home leaves for onboarding from the wallet's state, so it also does when the Settings page was swiped away while the wallet was removed; unit tests cover that race, which is too short to drive. Emulator and physical watch (`run-as` works on any debug build).
Precondition: Restored wallet, see journeys/wear/README.md › Restored wallet. Backend: hosted regtest. The journey leaves no wallet; restore one again for the journeys that need it. Read the screen size once with `adb shell wm size` and use the swipe written for it: 454 px (`Wear_Large_Round_API37`) or 384 px (`Wear_Small_Round_API34`); for another size scale it as in README › What differs.

actions.action: Run `adb shell run-as to.bitkit.dev ls no_backup/seed` and verify it lists one file, the encrypted seed
Swipe the pager left: on a 454 px screen `adb shell input swipe 400 227 60 227 300`, on a 384 px screen `adb shell input swipe 340 192 50 192 300`
Run `adb shell run-as to.bitkit.dev ls no_backup/seed` and verify it prints nothing: the encrypted seed is deleted
